name: Sofia Ghosh
life: “I still remember stepping off a release bus into a changed street.” Wednesday often includes a stop at the entrance to the Wash House, where Sofia stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: I got out first and know the shock of seeing new windows in old walls. I'm taking the long walk beside him.
appearance: Sofia is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Usually dressed in a rust-colored canvas coat with a small enamel bird on the lapel, Sofia turns fully toward the person speaking when listening.
personality: Is a careful borrower and a reckless lender. Things leave this person's house with elaborate instructions and very little expectation of ever coming back.
agenda: To walk the changed route beside the returning resident.
family: Tali Peters is Sofia’s stepsibling. Sofia chooses the music. Tali puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *Summer staff*, Tali says, “I never told my kid this was a seasonal job.”
connections: Joel Gomes. The walking companion brings the returning man to an uncle who has offered a bed with limits.

reactions.situation: The returning father asks to visit the old address
reactions.response: Sofia checks whether the person living there now wants visitors.

reactions.situation: A family supper turns into an argument about old debt
reactions.response: Sofia asks each person to say what they believe is actually owed before anybody proposes a payment.

reactions.response: Sofia listens first to the account of how it was actually used.
